title: zazzled source component diagram
description: The parts of the zazzled crate's source. Three front ends (the socket server, the MCP server and in-process run) feed command lines to the commands, which run on one shared engine; the MCP proxy and `zazzle run` are separate subcommands of the same binary that reuse clean's steps. clean, `zazzle run` and the proxy keep their outputs in the output store, from which read-again gives them back. All of it is one binary.

components.name: zazzled source
components.responsibility: The zazzled library and binary.

components.name: Command line (main.rs, cli.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses `zazzled serve|mcp|proxy|wrap|install|uninstall|run|version`, opens the engine with its cache and output store and starts the chosen front end, or hands proxy and wrap to their folders.

components.name: Socket server (server.rs)
components.responsibility: Binds the private socket (or takes launchd's), serves connections on 2 to 8 worker threads, checks the peer's uid, receives the request and passed descriptors, runs the command and answers; flushes the cache every 100 ms and exits when idle.

components.name: Wire format (proto.rs)
components.responsibility: Encodes and decodes the length-prefixed request, limits its size, and does the relay round trip.

components.name: Socket client (client.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds the socket path, calls the daemon in relay mode, and starts `zazzled serve` and retries when no daemon is listening.

components.name: MCP server (mcp.rs, mcp_structure.rs)
components.responsibility: Answers newline-delimited JSON-RPC on standard input and output: initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call for the thirteen zazzle tools (seven file tools, six structure tools answered by the indexer), each call forwarded to the daemon under one session per connection.

components.name: launchd integration (launchd.rs)
components.responsibility: Takes the socket launchd opened, writes and loads or unloads the LaunchAgent, and runs external programs with a timeout.

components.name: Engine (engine.rs, meta.rs)
components.responsibility: Shared daemon state: loads files with their metadata (BLAKE3 hash, line starts, binary, minified and CRLF flags; line anchors on demand), keeps a hot cache validated by stat, gives ls and find a light summary without hashing, caches outlines by content hash, holds the walk cache, the session table, the output store's directory, the edit lock and the counters.

components.name: Persistent cache (store.rs)
components.responsibility: The append-only log of per-path summaries under the cache directory: checksums, torn-tail repair, compaction on open, flushed by the server.

components.name: Walker (walk.rs)
components.responsibility: Lists the files under a root honouring .gitignore, .ignore and git's exclude file, applies globs, and reuses a listing while every directory and ignore file keeps its stat, checked on the pool.

components.name: Outliner (outline.rs, arena.rs)
components.responsibility: Symbols with line ranges: tree-sitter for Rust, Python, C, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript and TSX up to 1 MiB, its allocations in a per-thread arena during each parse; headings, tables and keys for Markdown, TOML and JSON; keywords and indentation for the rest.

components.name: Symbol finder (symbols.rs)
components.responsibility: Resolves a symbol name or qualified name, with optional parameter types, to one outline symbol, lists candidates otherwise, and finds the comments and attributes above it.

components.name: Parameter lists (params.rs)
components.responsibility: Splits a query's `Name(T1, T2)` and a declaration's parameter list, and compares them by type, or by name for untyped parameters.

components.name: Thread pool (pool.rs)
components.responsibility: One pool of threads per process, started on first use; par_map runs borrowed work on the caller and pool helpers and returns results in item order.

components.name: C# indexer bridge (indexer.rs)
components.responsibility: Finds zazzle-csharp-indexer and its state directory, starts its daemon when nothing listens, says hello with the indexer's version and the git work tree, asks its `view` tool for a C# file's terse view and its structure tools for overview, find_symbol, changed_since, git_log, git_blame and report_gap, and rewrites root:path references for the working directory.

components.name: Session table (session.rs)
components.responsibility: Gives each response a short id per session, replaces a repeat within the window by an "already sent" notice, and remembers the request behind each id for read-again.

components.name: Output store (outputs.rs)
components.responsibility: Keeps outputs that cannot be produced again (clean, run, proxy) on disk under a ten-character id derived from their text: the text shown and the full input, in an owner-only directory; each save drops entries older than an hour and, past the size limit, the oldest until half the bytes remain.

components.name: Helpers (args.rs, tokens.rs, util.rs)
components.responsibility: Flag parsing with one-line errors, token estimates, path display and resolution, ranking and line clipping.

components.name: zazzle commands
components.responsibility: find, read, ls, outline, refs, edit, clean, read-again and status.

components.name: MCP proxy
components.responsibility: `zazzled proxy`: cleans another MCP server's results, over stdio or Streamable HTTP.

components.name: zazzle run
components.responsibility: `zazzled wrap`: runs a command and prints its output cleaned with a profile.

components.name: launchd
components.responsibility: macOS's service manager: owns the socket of an installed LaunchAgent and starts `zazzled serve` on the first connection; driven with launchctl.

components.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer
components.responsibility: The C# tool in this repository whose daemon answers `view` and the structure tools over its own unix socket; it lists no tools to clients.
